mapper.sql: id, appid, message_key, user_key, request_fingerprint, question_id, processor_token, status, correct, point_awarded, reply_content, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wx_daily_vote_receipt (appid, message_key, user_key, request_fingerprint, question_id, processor_token, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{appid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{messageKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{requestFingerprint,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{questionId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{processorToken,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'PROCESSING', #{createTime,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{updateTime,jdbcType=BIGINT}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id

INSERT INTO wx_daily_vote_message_receipt (receipt_id, appid, message_key, user_key, request_fingerprint, question_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{receiptId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{appid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{messageKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{requestFingerprint,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{questionId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{createTime,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{updateTime,jdbcType=BIGINT}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
mapper.select: SELECT id, receipt_id, appid, message_key, user_key, request_fingerprint, question_id, create_time, update_time FROM wx_daily_vote_message_receipt WHERE appid = #{appid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND message_key = #{messageKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT r.id, r.appid, m.message_key, m.user_key, m.request_fingerprint, m.question_id, r.processor_token, r.status, r.correct, r.point_awarded, r.reply_content, r.create_time, r.update_time FROM wx_daily_vote_message_receipt m INNER JOIN wx_daily_vote_receipt r ON r.id = m.receipt_id WHERE m.appid = #{appid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND m.message_key = #{messageKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND r.appid = m.appid AND r.user_key = m.user_key AND r.question_id = m.question_id AND r.status = 'COMPLETED' LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM wx_daily_vote_receipt WHERE id = #{id,jdbcType=BIGINT} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
